import re

if 'ather_observation' not in content:
    content = content.replace(\"eva_observation: 'Ather 周观察'\", \"eva_observation: 'Ather 周观察',\n    ather_observation: 'Ather 周观察'\")

content = re.sub(r'\bEva\b', 'Ather', content)
if 'ather_observation' not in content:
    content = content.replace(\"eva_observation: 'Ather Weekly Observations'\", \"eva_observation: 'Ather Weekly Observations',\n    ather_observation: 'Ather Weekly Observations'\")

    f.write(content)
